description.value:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Your nanites shoot forth and wrap around the limbs of a creature within 10 feet, binding them together with a powerful magnetic force. The target must attempt a Reflex save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Off-Guard] to the next attack made against it.

Failure As success, and the creature is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Suppressed] until the end of its next turn.

Critical Failure As success, and the creature is suppressed until the end of its next turn and knocked @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Prone].
